description: This file defines data structures and methods for handling comment tags with typed arguments in the Kubernetes code generation context. It includes definitions for Tag, Arg, and related types, along with methods for parsing and representing tags.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a single comment tag with typed arguments, including methods for string representation and argument retrieval.

classes.name: Arg
classes.description: Represents an argument within a tag, including its name, value, and type.

methods.name: PositionalArg
methods.description: Returns the positional argument if present.

methods.name: NamedArg
methods.description: Returns a named argument if it exists.

methods.name: String (Tag)
methods.description: Returns the canonical string representation of the tag.

methods.name: String (Arg)
methods.description: Returns the string representation of an argument.
